page.layout: One page, title page. Centred title block at top, with the title, author line and printer's imprint. A woodcut engraving (ornamental frame with a standing female figure holding a staff and scales) sits in the middle. Below it, the place and printer's line and the date, all centred.
page.notes: Woodcut engraving in the centre of the page: an ornamental strapwork frame with a head at the top, enclosing a standing female figure with a staff in one hand and a pair of scales in the other. Not transcribed as text. Printing features: "Vuitebergensis" is printed with a lowercase-style u after the initial V; per the u/v rule, the consonant is given as v, so it is written "Vvitebergensis". Please check against the scan. The date is printed as cIↄ Iↄ XXcVII with reversed C's, rendered as MDXCVII. The printed title has no running head, page number, catchword or signature.
